sources.title: Sarvam-105B model card
sources.evidence: Official exact-model card identifies Sarvam-105B as a text-generating MoE reasoning model, gives nominal 10.3B active parameters, Apache-2.0 metadata, and top-8 routing among 128 experts with one shared expert.

sources.title: Introducing Indus — February 20, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated announcement explicitly opens Indus, powered by the 105B model, in limited beta with staged access and a possible waitlist.

sources.title: Open-Sourcing Sarvam 30B and 105B — March 6, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated weights release links the exact 105B Hugging Face checkpoint; specifies its MoE Transformer with MLA and describes model-generated tool calls in Indus. This is later than the February Indus beta.

sources.title: Sarvam-105B configuration
sources.evidence: 32 layers; one initial dense layer; 4096 hidden width; 262144 vocabulary; untied embeddings; 128 routed experts, top-8 and one shared expert; 131072 positions with YaRN scaling. Float32; no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Sarvam-105B complete checkpoint index and all indexed headers
sources.evidence: All 85 indexed shard headers were fetched using bounded HTTP 206 byte ranges at this revision; all 12289 keys, shapes, dtypes and shard assignments reconciled. F32 serialized elements total 106031767424, matching index metadata. No full weight payloads were downloaded.

sources.title: Sarvam-105B model implementation
sources.evidence: Static inspection of enabled branches reconciles every header shape. There are 31 persistent 128-element router correction buffers, with no backpropagation gradient; subtract their 3968 elements. Embedding and LM head are separate; rotary caches are nonpersistent. No quantized packing, quantization scales, MTP or auxiliary heads occur.

sources.title: Sarvam-105B configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Configuration defaults plus config.json select direct Q projection, MLA KV bottleneck, 32 blocks, 31 MoE layers, and untied input/output matrices. No additional enabled learned tensors are missing from the checkpoint.

sources.title: Sarvam-105B chat template
sources.evidence: Template supports text messages, optional thinking output, tool declarations, generated function calls and tool responses. It does not define image or audio inputs.

sources.title: Sarvam-105B API documentation
sources.evidence: Current API documentation identifies sarvam-105b as the reasoning model, with 128K context and Apache 2.0 weights; separately identifies the 32K sarvam-105b-conversations variant. Describes total size as 105B+, not an exact 105 billion.

sources.title: Everything we announced at Sarvam Epoch
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison research says the first Sarvam 105B checkpoint was released in February and distinguishes subsequent conversational/work-agent variants. It provides no replacement exact parameter count for the original checkpoint.

name.note: Developer names this model Sarvam-105B/Sarvam 105B; preserve the existing display spelling.

developer.note: Published and trained by Sarvam AI.

family.note: Catalog family key for the developer’s Sarvam model line.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit primary availability located: Indus limited beta on February 20. The baseline February 18 corresponds to the unveiling reported elsewhere; public usability on that day was not established. March 6 is the later weights release, not the first accessible model date. Repository creation is not release evidence.

open_weights.note: The original 105B checkpoint is publicly downloadable; March 6 announcement explicitly releases its weights.

license.note: Exact-model card license metadata and official API documentation agree.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned-parameter count at the cited checkpoint revision: 106031767424 F32 serialized elements minus 3968 router correction buffer elements. Includes both untied vocabulary matrices and every enabled transformer/expert tensor. All indexed keys and shapes reconcile; no quantization, packing, MTP, auxiliary heads or shared-storage aliases. This is not the nominal model-name size.

active_parameters_b.note: Primary nominal active count, retained at the card’s precision. Its convention is not explicitly defined. Top-8 routed experts plus all non-vocabulary parameters total 10267414528, consistent with rounding to 10.3B; counting both full vocabulary matrices instead yields 12414898176. Do not interpret 10.3B as a complete storage count or assume total equals active.

architecture.note: Decoder-only MoE Transformer with MLA, 32 blocks (one dense, 31 MoE), 128 routed experts per MoE block, eight selected and one always-on shared expert; RMSNorm and YaRN rotary positions.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint max_position_embeddings is 131072, agreeing with the API’s 128K advertised context; the distinct conversations variant has 32K.

modalities.note: Causal text model with token embeddings and text/tool template. Speech or diagram handling in the surrounding Indus application does not establish native audio or vision for these weights.

reasoning.note: Developer documents reasoning and the template supports optional thinking traces.

tool_call.note: Developer examples and checkpoint template establish model-generated tool calls and observation handling.

description.value: Multilingual text model with MoE routing, MLA attention, reasoning and tool calling, trained from scratch by Sarvam AI.
description.note: Replaces promotional flagship/enterprise language with directly supported technical facts.

patch.description: Multilingual text model with MoE routing, MLA attention, reasoning and tool calling, trained from scratch by Sarvam AI.

sources.label: Sarvam-105B complete checkpoint index and all indexed headers

patch.notes: First documented access was the Indus limited beta on 2026-02-20; open weights followed on 2026-03-06. Complete checkpoint learned-parameter count: 106.031763456B, excluding 3968 persistent router buffer elements from 106031767424 F32 stored elements. The developer’s 10.3B active figure is nominal and its counting convention is unstated; it agrees with rounded non-vocabulary active capacity, rather than counting both full vocabulary matrices. Counts describe the original public checkpoint, not later conversational/work-agent revisions.

parameter_accounting.active_convention_note: Both calculated active totals use eight routed experts per MoE layer plus shared experts and dense tensors. The developer reports only a nominal 10.3B; the non-vocabulary match is an inference, not an explicit provider convention.

summary: Corrected complete learned size to 106.031763456B after all 85 shard headers and enabled code reconciled; added primary nominal 10.3B active, MoE architecture and Apache-2.0 license. Corrected earliest documented access to February 20 limited beta and separated March 6 weights release. Replaced promotional description. Original text/reasoning/tool/131072-context fields confirmed; later variants were not substituted.
